author: Botwe-Felix5820
description: Rounded sky-blue button that starts animating on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, starts the shake3856 animation (sliding).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nasty Deer 97</title>
<style>
/* Nasty Deer 97 by Botwe-Felix5820 — https://uiverse.io/Botwe-Felix5820/nasty-deer-97 */
button {
 height: 3em;
 width: 8em;
 border: none;
 border-radius: 10em;
 background: #016DD9;
 font-size: 17px;
 color: #ffffff;
 font-family: inherit;
 font-weight: 500;
}

button:hover {
 animation: shake3856 0.3s linear infinite both;
}

@keyframes shake3856 {
 0% {
  -webkit-transform: translate(0);
  transform: translate(0);
 }

 20% {
  -webkit-transform: translate(-2px, 2px);
  transform: translate(-2px, 2px);
 }

 40% {
  -webkit-transform: translate(-2px, -2px);
  transform: translate(-2px, -2px);
 }

 60% {
  -webkit-transform: translate(2px, 2px);
  transform: translate(2px, 2px);
 }

 80% {
  -webkit-transform: translate(2px, -2px);
  transform: translate(2px, -2px);
 }

 100% {
  -webkit-transform: translate(0);
  transform: translate(0);
 }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> Shake
</button>

</body>
</html>
